data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is caused by a tool error in the qwen model (HTTP 400 BadRequestError when auditing the PKGBUILD), which forced an inconclusive verdict. The deepseek model successfully audited the PKGBUILD and found it to be a standard, safe VCS packaging script.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit the PKGBUILD due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400), resulting in an incomplete audit.
learnings: The audit tool should implement retry logic for transient API errors (like HTTP 400/500) instead of immediately failing the file audit and cascading to an inconclusive package verdict.

When aggregating multiple model reports, if one model fails due to a tool error but another successfully completes a full audit with a safe verdict, the system should be able to override the inconclusive status and accept the complete safe verdict.
